cases.title: Walk the native seeded world
cases.rationale: The presentation must show the current camp and stable subjects while the controlled actor moves.
cases.setup: Field seed, one Windows viewport.
actions: Use normal Start and physical D, then release.
cases.expected: A current native draw shows a moved local actor, stationary bodies and distinct living/broken defense states.
cases.reset: Use ordinary Escape to return to the menu in the same owned viewport. Quit normally after the group.
cases.freshProcessReason: The group owns one physical viewport separate from the four-peer session.

cases.title: Exercise movement and panel capture
cases.rationale: The real input poll, stamina and air control must agree with the HUD.
cases.setup: Field seed with actual carried load.
actions: Walk, hold Shift+D, jump, reverse in air, land, open I and press Space.
cases.expected: Distinct walk, sprint and airborne state, real stamina cost and no world jump while the panel owns input.
cases.reset: Use ordinary Escape to return to the menu in the same owned viewport. Quit normally after the group.
cases.freshProcessReason: The group owns one physical viewport separate from the four-peer session.

cases.title: Handle real nested inventory and quick food
cases.rationale: Only actual native controls can prove physical inventory and preview behavior.
cases.setup: Field seed with a nested pouch, six berries and rotatable arrows.
actions: Open equipment and bags, assign a berry stack, split it, rotate arrows into an empty cell and use slot 1.
cases.expected: Eleven slots, current nested identities, exact quantities, committed rotation and a visible cooldown.
cases.reset: Use ordinary Escape to return to the menu in the same owned viewport. Quit normally after the group.
cases.freshProcessReason: The group owns one physical viewport separate from the four-peer session.

cases.title: Page and withdraw from the reachable stash
cases.rationale: Native paging and scoped withdrawal must stay consistent with actual authority.
cases.setup: Field seed with the stash within reach and two configured pages.
actions: Open E, select stash, move page forward/back, Ctrl-click money, close and leave reach.
cases.expected: Native page index follows committed pages. The real amount moves and remote scope disappears.
cases.reset: Use ordinary Escape to return to the menu in the same owned viewport. Quit normally after the group.
cases.freshProcessReason: The group owns one physical viewport separate from the four-peer session.

cases.title: Aim, fire, exhaust ammunition and resolve a defense hit
cases.rationale: Real ammunition and aim must drive the appearance and wear seen by the player.
cases.setup: Bow seed, one opposite-hand arrow and stationary hostile bowman.
actions: Move pointer to aim and click twice, then trigger the stationary hostile through its fixture route.
cases.expected: Current crosshair and one-arrow HUD, one wear change, quiet empty aim and a destroyed defense.
cases.reset: Use ordinary Escape to return to the menu in the same owned viewport. Quit normally after the group.
cases.freshProcessReason: The group owns one physical viewport separate from the four-peer session.

cases.title: Observe a real corpse, Respawn and cleanup
cases.rationale: A native death and explicit transfer must keep the actual old gear on the corpse.
cases.setup: Life seed with actual armor and a one-health controlled survivor.
actions: Trigger stationary melee, inspect spectator card, click Respawn and step the empty lifetime.
cases.expected: The committed corpse has actual gear and no crown. The same binding controls a fresh survivor and empty-only cleanup is visible.
cases.reset: Use ordinary Escape to return to the menu in the same owned viewport. Quit normally after the group.
cases.freshProcessReason: The group owns one physical viewport separate from the four-peer session.

cases.title: Observe a normal four-role production roster
cases.rationale: Four real instruments are needed to verify shared presentation and separate private views.
cases.setup: Ordinary Host and three isolated guest profiles on an owned loopback port.
actions: Physically join each role then move one guest with D.
cases.expected: Four distinct bindings and crowns across a normal eight-survivor roster, with matching guest movement and disjoint scopes.
cases.reset: Return the guests then host to normal menus, re-form the group on the same owned processes, then quit all roles.
cases.freshProcessReason: The whole group needs the same four native windows, isolated profiles and port.

cases.title: Observe contested stash and recipient correction
cases.rationale: Only the first withdrawal may take the shared item, and each physical panel must show its current rights.
cases.setup: Field seed with host and three guests near the same stash.
actions: Open nearby Stash, try the original cell from two guests, test movement capture and leave reach.
cases.expected: One actual withdrawal, a corrected or denied losing action, preserved personal totals and revoked remote scope.
cases.reset: Return the guests then host to normal menus, re-form the group on the same owned processes, then quit all roles.
cases.freshProcessReason: The whole group needs the same four native windows, isolated profiles and port.

cases.title: Follow, lose a teammate and explicitly Respawn
cases.rationale: Same-lifetime control and camera require actual separate native roles.
cases.setup: Life seed with host and three ordinary bound guest profiles.
actions: Trigger real melee, follow Next/Previous/list, leave and rejoin the selected guest, then click Respawn.
cases.expected: Fixed hold after loss, no automatic transfer, rejoined persistent teammate and one new same-binding crowned survivor.
cases.reset: Return the guests then host to normal menus, re-form the group on the same owned processes, then quit all roles.
cases.freshProcessReason: The whole group needs the same four native windows, isolated profiles and port.

cases.title: Exercise the seeded world and native movement
cases.rationale: Stationary range and air control must be observable in the production scene.
cases.setup: Start the field fixture with ordinary Start.
actions: Hold and release D, then press Space.
cases.expected: Distinct adjacent hostiles stay put, defenses retain their authored states and the controlled actor walks and jumps.
cases.reset: Return to the menu in the same solo process and start a distinct authority session.

cases.title: Check a normal run and exact initial stash
cases.rationale: The fixture must leave normal roster and stash construction unchanged.
cases.setup: Start normally with a fresh run in the same process.
actions: Move into stash reach and browse every actual page.
cases.expected: Eight ordinary survivors, the configured outfit and every configured distinct stack are present.
cases.reset: Return to the menu in the same solo process and start a distinct authority session.

cases.title: Read nested possessions and spend assigned food
cases.rationale: Nested carried identity and stale stamps must survive the native authority boundary.
cases.setup: Start the field fixture with a worn bag and pouch.
actions: Open I, request matching nested scopes, assign berries, close and press 1 twice, then submit the stale item reference.
cases.expected: The current item spends one berry, cooldown denies the second request and the stale stamp cannot assign.
cases.reset: Return to the menu in the same solo process and start a distinct authority session.

cases.title: Spend a real arrow and resolve a hostile shot
cases.rationale: The native input must consume actual ammo and the fixture must use actual defense damage.
cases.setup: Start the bow fixture with one opposite-hand arrow.
actions: Click to shoot twice, then trigger the stationary bowman and advance host time.
cases.expected: One arrow and weapon condition are spent. The empty bow does not wear and a real hostile projectile destroys the living wall.
cases.reset: Return to the menu in the same solo process and start a distinct authority session.

cases.title: Lose control, transfer by explicit Respawn and preserve remains
cases.rationale: Death must revoke private authority immediately and permit only a fresh eligible survivor.
cases.setup: Start the one-health life fixture.
actions: Trigger stationary melee, wait the gate, activate Respawn and advance host time.
cases.expected: One real corpse remains with actual gear, the same binding transfers, and only the empty pile expires.
cases.reset: Return to the menu in the same solo process and start a distinct authority session.

cases.title: Verify four independent scopes and contested stash
cases.rationale: Real ENet recipients must not receive another player’s private stamps or remote stash results.
cases.setup: Host the field fixture and join three isolated profiles on one owned loopback port.
actions: Observe all roles, race two current references to one stash item then leave its reach.
cases.expected: Four distinct live bindings have disjoint private rows. One withdrawal applies and the other loses access to the moved instance. Remote scope is revoked.
cases.reset: Quit the distinct four-peer set and the idle solo process normally.

cases.title: Build the complete solution with analyzers
cases.rationale: The actual C# sources and dependency graph must build under the enforced rules.
cases.setup: Use the pinned SDK and an authenticated Godot package feed.
actions: Restore the locked solution.
Build the solution with strict analyzers.
cases.expected: The full production and test solution restores and builds with zero analyzer errors or warnings.
cases.reset: Use checkout-scoped build inputs and release owned build processes.

cases.title: Check repository boundaries, documentation and catalog
cases.rationale: Misplaced code, missing documentation or invalid case metadata invalidate the shared verification entry point.
cases.setup: Use the repository checkout and the pinned Node version.
actions: Validate the current project and code boundaries.
Check documentation and shared catalog declarations.
cases.expected: All selected current-source boundary and documentation checks and catalog validation pass.
cases.reset: Use temporary files owned by the check and leave tracked source untouched.

cases.title: Run the pure production tests together
cases.rationale: Pure tests detect incorrect authoritative results and controlled-input regressions.
cases.setup: Use the strict build of the verification test project.
actions: Discover the pure tests.
Run their authoritative production assertions in a single test process.
cases.expected: The declared pure tests execute successfully with no missing or skipped results.
cases.reset: Each test gets fresh fixture inputs and state.

cases.title: Enter, move and quit the game headlessly
cases.rationale: Exercises production game code on both hosted operating systems.
cases.setup: Use the pinned Godot .NET engine, imported production project, and an isolated profile.
actions: Launch without a window.
Enter the game using its production input route.
Move the character.
Quit normally.
cases.expected: The run records the menu, entered scene, movement and a clean process exit.
cases.reset: Remove the isolated profile and temporary project after its report and logs are retained.

cases.title: Start the pinned portable release without a window
cases.rationale: Editor resources can resolve correctly while the released runtime has a missing or invalid dependency.
cases.setup: Export the current source with the pinned Windows release template and a clean isolated profile.
actions: Boot the unmodified release into the normal menu.
Use the owned probe companion for Start, movement, inventory and the two invalid configuration paths.
cases.expected: The unmodified release boots normally. Its executable and immutable gameplay resources drive actual production in the companion. Invalid variants stay at the menu and report their exact reasons.
cases.reset: Use isolated profiles. Require bounded exit from the unmodified boot and ordinary Quit from all probe variants.
evidence: verified release template and package closure
four current native receipts and process termination records

cases.title: Scheduled full regression testing
cases.rationale: A scheduled full selection detects failures in currently unaffected lower-priority cases.
cases.setup: Prepare the environments assigned during Phase 11 planning.
actions: Run every active case on the documented schedule.
cases.expected: The complete scope and corresponding logs and failures are inspectable.
cases.reset: Use owned run environments and preserve each initial and later result.

cases.title: Complete runner and platform certification
cases.rationale: Full platform checks and measured real production and analyzer coverage require the finished framework.
cases.setup: Use the Windows and Linux hosted environments and the exact required test inventory.
actions: Execute the complete test scope.
Measure the independent coverages.
Reconcile evidence, runner controls and deferred obligations.
cases.expected: Every certification obligation passes with measured line coverage at or above 90% and branch coverage at or above 80%.
cases.reset: Create isolated test processes, preserve originals and publish distinct reports.

cases.title: Play four-player LAN across separate Windows and Linux computers
cases.rationale: Packaged mixed-OS sessions expose discovery, network and compatibility behavior that local loopback does not exercise.
cases.setup: Install the release packages without development tooling on separate Windows and Linux computers on the same LAN. Use four independent participants.
actions: Record the tested package and system versions and the Linux distribution.
Join separate sessions using discovery and manual address.
Exercise a mismatched-content attempt, a late join, reconnect, shared actions and host loss through ordinary play.
cases.expected: Both join routes admit supported peers, the session has coherent four-player state, incompatible content is explained before control, and late-join and recovery behavior follow the release contract.
cases.reset: Start a fresh session for each join route and restore the compatible package after the incompatible-content check.
cases.freshProcessReason: Separate production installations, profile identities and computers establish the actual mixed-OS network.

cases.title: Measure the feature-complete rendered reference-PC stress session
cases.rationale: The finished game must maintain the specified displayed frame rate and responsiveness on the actual reference hardware.
cases.setup: Run the finished game on the creator's reference PC at 1920×1080 with four participants, about 100 recruited survivors and 300 active zombies. Keep full simulation, combat, equipment visuals and inventories active.
actions: Record CPU, graphics hardware, memory, OS, resolution, settings and game and content configuration.
Measure ten minutes of representative play with a dense battlefront, working NPCs, nested inventories, stash use and existing corpses.
Record displayed FPS each second and capture active-play save and join stalls separately.
cases.expected: At least 95% of one-second samples reach 30 displayed FPS, no stretch below 30 FPS exceeds five seconds, and no active-play save or join freeze exceeds 0.5 seconds.
cases.reset: Restore the starting load and use the same declared settings for an independently recorded measurement.
cases.freshProcessReason: The benchmark needs a dedicated configured release build and representative starting load on the reference PC.
evidence: sampling method and raw one-second FPS samples

cases.title: Play a three-hour saved and resumed endurance session
cases.rationale: Long-running ordinary play and returning to a saved session must preserve progression, accessible loot and inventory consistency.
cases.setup: Use the feature-complete release build and a documented starting campaign. Retain ordinary simulation, equipment, inventories and loot persistence.
actions: Play for at least three real hours with recurring battles.
Save, exit and resume through the ordinary production controls.
Account for at least 200 nonempty corpses or loot piles represented over the session and check accessible belongings and inventory consistency after resume.
cases.expected: Belongings remain accessible, inventories are consistent and there is no progression block throughout the saved and resumed session.
cases.reset: Keep the initial and resumed save artifacts separate, preserve failures and use a new campaign for a repeat.
cases.freshProcessReason: The saved game must survive exit and resume in a separate process, with the full session measured in real time.
